title: Check Group Exists
description: Check whether a Linux group exists.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

GROUP_NAME="${1:-}"

if [[ -z "$GROUP_NAME" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 groupname" >&2
    exit 1
fi

if getent group "$GROUP_NAME" >/dev/null; then
    getent group "$GROUP_NAME"
    echo "Group exists: $GROUP_NAME"
else
    echo "Group does not exist: $GROUP_NAME"
    exit 1
fi
